notes: Public Dec 15 2020. Has human newly-diagnosed + recurrent GBM samples (GSM4972210-12) BUT: (1) human raw data restricted to EGA EGAS00001004871 — GEO only has processed mouse data + limited human processed; (2) only 3 human samples (2 conditions not patient-matched longitudinal pairs); (3) NO treatment annotation in GEO metadata; (4) primarily mouse GL261 model dataset. Fails matched-pair and treatment-annotation criteria.

Public Jul 05 2022. Title: A single cell atlas of human glioma under therapy. 40 primary + 40 patient-matched recurrent IDH-wt GBM. ALL patients treated with standard-of-care: temozolomide + radiation + surgical resection. Also includes snATAC-seq + spatial transcriptomics (10x Visium) + spatial proteomics (NanoString GeoMx). 113 samples on GEO. Raw data in SRA (PRJNA730532). Processed data downloadable from GEO FTP. Published Nature Cancer 2022 (PMID 36539501). Best available dataset.

Public Dec 15 2021. Title: A glioma immune cell atlas. 18 GBM patients multiregional sampling. Has ndGBM and rGBM labels but NOT confirmed patient-matched longitudinal pairs (different patients for nd vs r). No treatment annotation in GEO metadata. 201986 cells total. Published Nat Commun 2022 (PMID 35140215). Useful for immune cell atlas but fails matched-pair criterion.
Human raw data from GSE163120 deposited to EGA study EGAS00001004871. Restricted access — requires EGA application. Not publicly downloadable. Fails public-access criterion.
Neftel et al. 2019 Cell. Primary GBM only (no recurrent). No treatment annotation. Classic GBM cell-state reference dataset. Fails matched-pair and treatment criteria.
Darmanis et al. 2017 Cell Reports. Primary GBM scRNA-seq. No recurrent samples. No treatment annotation. Small cell count. Fails matched-pair criterion.
